answer: A distinct payout rail per agent makes bulk fakes slow. Each newcomer must link one payout account that has cleared two micro-deposits, and rewards go only to that account, never to another agent. Opening an account takes three to five days of identity checks, so a farmer wanting one hundred agents needs one hundred verified accounts. If two agents share a rail, both are frozen and pending earnings are forfeited. You cannot simply forge a walnut copy and expect it to survive a glacier crossing: every identity must carry its own checkable trail.
